symptoms: Bright yellow-orange circular spots with red borders on upper leaf surface
Small black fungal dots (pycnia) within the orange spots
Cluster cups (aecia) with tube-like protrusions on underside of leaves
risk_factors: Presence of alternate host (Eastern Red Cedar / Juniper) within 1-2 km
Wet spring weather when cedar galls release orange gelatinous spore horns
prevention: Remove nearby ornamental junipers and red cedars if feasible
Plant resistant apple varieties (e.g. Redfree, Liberty, Freedom)
recommended_actions: Apply myclobutanil or sulfur sprays in early spring during cedar spore release
